January 18, 1982

LOUISVILLE

bwit
INTERNAL CORRESPONDENCE

TO: MR. J. F. ROBERTS

RE: LUCKY STRIKE Deliveries - Tar Review Meeting

I would like to take this opportunity to respond to those questions on LUCKY STRIKE raised at the last Tar Review Committee Meeting (see attached):

#1. LSF for Japan has recently been discontinued.

#2. Yes. We wish to reduce deliveries on LUCKY STRIKE Plain to meet the previously established targets of 18.0 tar and 1.3 nicotine. However, we wish to avoid a total reformulation of the cigarette.

#3. Yes. We would like LSF Box (red stripe) deliveries slightly higher. In order not to exceed 15.0 tar and 1.0 nicotine, the new targets for this brand (including 84mm) should be 14.5 and .9.

G. B. MININGHAM
/1kc

cc: Mr. J. J. Howley
Mr. W. L. Telling
Mr. B. R. O'Hare
